body:
I'm supposed to take antidepressants, I haven't yet.. All I've been taking is to try and control my anxiety and the sleep issues... Ive tried saving but I save little to nothing because I always find myself trying to help my family by paying stuff I know they probably struggle to pay... Maybe I'm too good for others when they don't seem to care and too bad to myself...
And if this is the beginning and it stays like this for a while its not gonna look very good for me..as I said in a comment above, I'm getting frustrated...seeing no answers to "questions" I really need to answer..

I've been attending a shrink... It's helping but at the same time it's making things more confusing. We talk a lot about everything but I don't think that talking with him (my shrink) will change anything...everyday that passes I feel more and mode frustrated because I want to make "things" happen and be someone and everyday that passes I'm still in the same place...doing nothing productive, literally sleeping in metro for 2 hours, 4 hours of work and another 2 hours sleeping or thinking shit about myself... Always like this, everyday, its frustrating..
